description: The ops reviewer sees a change to pricing that the card did not flag as business-critical and escalates it: its pass carries needs-human, so the merge agent and the gate will hold the merge for a person.

card.title: Carts over 100 get a 10% discount
card.body:
## Problem
Shoppers with large carts pay full price; the campaign promises 10% off above 100.

## Context
- **Where:** `src/cart.mjs`, new function `total`
- **Who:** every shopper

## Fix
Add `total(prices)`: the sum, with 10% off when the sum is over 100.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `total([60, 60])` returns `108`
- [ ] `total([50, 50])` returns `100`
- [ ] A test in `test/` asserts both cases

## Risk
🟢 **Low** · one pure function

setup.sh: git add -A && git commit -qm "✨ [feat] cart: 10% off carts over 100"
